source.name: Zawya (APO Group, on behalf of the BAL): Basketball Africa League Names PUMA as League's Official Outfitter Ahead of 2026 Season
source.quote: a multiyear collaboration that makes PUMA the Official Outfitter of the BAL
source.note: Multiyear deal beginning with the 2026 BAL season; no deal value reported. League-wide partner, attached to no single club.
